title: Japchae
description: Korean stir-fried sweet potato glass noodles with spinach, carrots, mushrooms and onion in a sweet, savory sesame-soy sauce.

image.alt: A plate of glass noodles with spinach, carrot, peppers and sesame

steps.text: Cook the noodles in boiling water until soft and chewy, {time 6-7 min}. Drain, rinse with cold water and snip them into shorter lengths with scissors.
Stir the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and garlic together. Toss the noodles with a third of it.
Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the onion and carrots for {time 3 min}, then the mushrooms for {time 3 min}.
Add the spinach and scallions and stir until just wilted, {time 1 min}.
Add the noodles and the rest of the sauce and toss until glossy and heated through, {time 2-3 min}. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve warm or at room temperature.

notes: Japchae is often served at room temperature, so it’s good for making ahead.
Sweet potato glass noodles are gluten-free; use tamari to keep the whole dish gluten-free.
